title: Slides: send image-heavy pages to the model as images (vision, not OCR)
description:
Problem: the current instructor's slides are image-heavy. pdftotext/pandoc only extract text, so diagram/plot/screenshot slides arrive as a bare title or nothing. Image files in artifacts/ and sources/ are skipped entirely (workspace.rs ~L529, reconcile.rs ~L513).

Worse than missing content: slides.rs ~L253 drops slides with no lines after boilerplate stripping (.filter(|s| !s.lines.is_empty())), so an image-only slide vanishes with no trace, and title-only slides can get eaten by the Jaccard dedup. The model can't even tell something was there.

Decision: skip OCR (tesseract). Clunky, and OCR only recovers text, while most lecture images are diagrams/plots/code screenshots. The backends can look at images directly.

Plan (~half day):
1. Sparse-text detection per page during slide extraction: under N words (start ~8, after boilerplate stripping) = visual. Keep these slides instead of dropping them, and exempt them from dedup.
2. PDF: render only the visual pages with pdftoppm (poppler, same package as pdftotext, so no new dependency), e.g. pdftoppm -png -r 110 -f N -l N, into the workspace next to the extracted text (e.g. _artifacts/<deck>-p<N>.png).
3. Put a marker in the slide markdown: [slide N: mostly visual, see _artifacts/<deck>-p<N>.png].
4. One line in claude.md (and the Pi variant later): when a slide is marked visual, look at the image before the debrief.
5. PPTX: pull the embedded images out of ppt/media/ via the slide rels (already zip-reading for XML), or convert to PDF with soffice if installed and reuse the PDF path. Images can be the fallback.
6. Optional: let image files dropped in artifacts/ be copied into the workspace and listed instead of skipped.

Guards: cap images per session (e.g. 30) with a warning; no-op gracefully if pdftoppm is missing (keep the text marker, warn once); teardown must not merge _artifacts/ back.

Tests: fixture deck with a text slide plus a blank/title-only slide. Assert the visual slide is kept, marked, not deduped, and gets an image path. Assert the missing-pdftoppm fallback.

Pi plan note: the main tutor model needs vision; with path-confined read, images must live inside the workspace (they will).
